newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy treasury says STET transfer on.
newsitem.headline: Italy treasury says STET transfer on.

text.p: The Italian treasury said on Wednesday that a plan to transfer control of Italian telecommunications giant STET to the treasury from state holding group IRI would not be sunk by a parliamentary vote against it.
A statement said the transfer had "already taken place" because it was attached to a part of the 1997 budget.
The Treasury issued the statement after the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) voted against the plan by a narrow margin.
It said the government reserved the right to provide "appropriate solutions" to complete those aspects of the plan that were regulated by the decree that was botched by parliament.
It added that the planned fusion of STET and Telecom Italia would also go ahead as planned. Rome newsroom - 39-6-678-2501
